description: Rule-based (deterministic) shortlist of up to 5 in-stock bags for a trip: size from trip length and travellers, airline cabin fit, budget, popularity and current discounts. Each pick has short reasons. Use when the user asks 'what suitcase should I take/buy for …'.

airline.description: Airline name or slug (cabin picks must fit it).

budget_eur.description: Maximum price per bag in EUR.

checked_bag_ok.description: false = cabin baggage only (no checked bag). Default true.

market.description: Store market: 'ee' = kohvrimaailm.ee (Estonian), 'lv' = koferuveikals.lv (Latvian). Defaults to the domain this server was reached on. Prices, titles and links follow the market.

travellers.description: Number of travellers sharing the luggage.

name: recommend_for_trip
title: Recommend luggage for a trip
